observations: PCI/legacy IRQ request at 1416 and MSI-X request dispatch at 1423 precede bottom_half_q setup at 1447-1448 and rm_init_adapter at 1468; NV_FLAG_OPEN is set at 1493.
The ISR calls RM MMU-fault handling before UVM and RM ISR paths; it may enqueue bottom_half_q at 2918 when RM reports serviceable faults.
Adapter shutdown calls rm_disable_adapter at 1947, stops bottom_half_q at 1950, frees the unlocked ISR mutex at 1958-1961, then frees IRQs at 1967 or releases MSI-X at 1982-1986.
Persistent SW-state last close calls rm_disable_adapter without releasing IRQs; native PM stops bottom_half_q at 6560 and recreates it on resume at 6569-6572 while the handler remains registered.
nvidia_suspend holds ldata_lock at 6718; the deferred open worker takes it at 1743, so queue flush while holding it is a potential lock-order/liveness concern, not a reproduced deadlock.
Queue stop flushes before setting main_loop_should_exit (119-141); scheduling checks that flag before raw enqueue (282-292), not inside the q_lock section (252-270).
The canonical frontend validates the backend and returns -EOPNOTSUPP from its IRQ drain callback at lines 300-314.
Explicit Linux enable_irq/disable_irq controls in these paths apply to SoC/platform or GPIO IRQ lines; they are not a mask for the PCI main-GPU interrupt source.

limitations: Source ordering does not prove an interrupt ran in any initialization, queue-stop, or resume window.
The PC6 20-file snapshot excluded the proprietary RM binary and several source files; claims about excluded inputs are not used as primary proof.
The existing bounded Ghidra reports are decompiler reconstructions, not NVIDIA source; indirect callback targets and hardware IRQ semantics remain unresolved.
No provider module, kernel driver, GPU, UVM transition, suspend/resume cycle, CUDA kernel, or performance test was run for this audit.
decision: Retain the hybrid frontend drain_irqs -EOPNOTSUPP guard. Do not reorder free_irq or add synchronize_irq until the PCI source-mask, threaded-handler completion, queue ownership, and provider teardown lifetime are source-backed and tested.
next_experiment: Use the exact pinned nv-kernel.o_binary to inspect the direct rm_init_adapter and rm_isr callees, then follow only unresolved interrupt-enable or readiness dispatches. Reconcile with the existing rm_disable_adapter and rm_power_management decompilations before modifying either provider.
